description: Connects your domain to your PageHub website.
variableDescription: %ip%: IPv4 address the PageHub site answers on (Vercel edge), used for the apex A record; %cname%: per-project Vercel CNAME target for www (e.g. d1a2b3c4.vercel-dns-017.com); %verify%: Vercel domain-ownership token, only sent when the domain was previously attached to another Vercel account
